name: Bench: Command: Undead (504907) credits the necromancer for a minion kill without a swing
contract: SoloKill.RequirePlayerHit (#10365, default 1) gives an ungrouped player experience from a creature only if they 'hit' it themselves (Creature::AddDirectPlayerAttacker, Spell.cpp:3130 / Unit.cpp:1317). Command: Undead 504907 is one of the generic Commands (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp Responds(), alongside 500991/504868/504908/805871) that answer any non-Stationary minion. A level-60 necromancer raises one Greater Skeletal Warrior (51065, via Raise: Greater Skeletal Warrior 504901) and never swings; Command: Undead on a weak creature lets the warrior kill it alone. This bench proves on unfixed main whether that commanded kill gives the necromancer experience (intended behaviour, 'option A': every Command order counts as the player's hit).

steps.label: SETUP: the Greater Skeletal Warrior exists
BENCH: the commanded kill gives experience
BENCH: the necromancer's level is unchanged
